areas: Palm Desert, the Coachella Valley, and Southern California

hero.eyebrow: For homeowners across the Coachella Valley
hero.h1: Outdoor Lighting Design in Palm Desert
hero.sub: Path lights, step lights, well lights, up lights, and wall washers, in warm white, cool white, or full color. Our designers lay out the property, show you a night-time demo, then our installers set and aim every light.

items.p: Low path lights along walks and planting beds, so the way to the door is lit and nothing glares.
Well lights and wall washers along the drive and across the front of the house. The entry is the first thing a guest sees.
Surface-mount step lights and strip lighting on stair edges and decks, so each step shows and no fixture is underfoot.

about.h2: A Coachella Valley team, led by Sabrina
about.p: Sabrina grew up in the Coachella Valley, and her team designs and installs outdoor lighting that gives a home the feel of a resort. Customer service comes first, and you can come in and plan the design with the team at the design center on CA-111 in Palm Desert.

items.p: I hired Innovative Outdoor Lighting for a landscape lighting project at my Palm Desert home and had a great experience from start to finish. Sabrina, the owner, was extremely responsive and easy to communicate with when scheduling and planning the project.
Sabrina and team really stick the landing - from bidding and design to installation I was so glad to have gone with IO Lighting. Clean work, no baby sitting - just great results.

Sabrina and her worker David did a great job replacing the lights in our backyard! From beginning to end the communication was good and every concern was addressed. Our backyard now lights up so beautifully at night!

steps.p: We come to the property, walk it with you, and note what you want to see lit.
Our designers draw the custom layout: each light, where it sits, and its color temperature.
A complimentary demo after dark on your own property, before you make a final decision.
Our installers set and wire every light, then aim each one after dark.

items.q: Which color temperature should I choose?
items.a: Warm white suits stone, stucco, and wood. Cooler white suits palms, water, and a modern home. The night-time demo shows both, so you pick by eye.

items.q: Do I need to know what I want before you come out?
items.a: No. Tell us what you want to see and we build it, or let our designers put a layout together from your property and your needs.

items.q: Can you add to the lighting I already have?
items.a: Yes. If you are happy with your system and only want a few fixtures replaced or added, we do that too.

items.q: Will outdoor lighting raise my power bill much?
items.a: Everything we install is high-efficiency LED, so a whole property draws far less than the old halogen systems did.
Palm Desert and the Coachella Valley, with projects throughout Southern California.

items.p: Landscape speakers that blend into the planting, and outdoor TVs for the patio and the pool.
Lighting set to keep the property seen after dark.
Lighting for the holidays or for one event.
Our installers, for a new system or for fixtures you already have.
Regular checks so every light keeps working and keeps its aim.
A light out or a wire cut: we find it and fix it.

final.h2: Book a meeting with our design team
final.p: Tell us about your property and pick a time. We come out, lay out the lighting, and show you a night-time demo before you decide.

footer.creds: Resale and wholesale design center. Professional-grade fixtures made in the USA.
